reviews.title: Restaurant Experience in Cala by Chris
reviews.text:
When we arrived at the restaurant, the staff gave us a very warm welcome. They were quick with their service and had no problem when we decided to change tables.
Regarding the food, it tasted fresh, and I liked that the fish was ice-cold; it added a nice touch to the ceviche. Among the areas for improvement would be the presentation of the dishes. It's not bad, but for someone who enjoys taking pictures of their food as me, I would have preferred it to look more aesthetically pleasing.
reviews.review_tip: You should definitely try the Limeño ceviche and you should visit Cala around 5 or 6 pm to enjoy the sunset while it arrives.

reviews.title: Worst dinning experience ever!!
reviews.text:
This was easily one of the worst dining experiences I’ve had. We visited on short notice for New Year’s Eve and were told they could accommodate us. We prepaid for the celebration, but the 'perks' we were promised were completely misrepresented. We were told a bottle of champagne was included; in reality, they simply offered to waive the corkage fee if we brought our own—which we didn't have since we were visiting from out of town.

The seating was also handled poorly. We were told the bar was first-come, first-served, yet midway through dinner, a staff member forced us to move so other guests could take our seats. To top it off, when I ordered a spicy margarita, I was told they were out of Triple Sec and offered Cointreau as a substitute. I wasn't told this would be an extra charge, yet it appeared as a separate line item on my bill. We spent over $600 USD for poor quality food and even poorer treatment. I would never return here even if the meal was free.

owner_response.text: We appreciate your visit and regret that you did not have a pleasant experience. Your feedback helps us continue to improve. Please contact us at jescalante@calarestaurante.com or provide us with a phone number so we can contact you.

reviews.title: Beyond beautiful.
reviews.text:
Antonio was able to be present and real in our experience we shared, while serving us he was able to make great conversation and give great service.

Sometimes being at a fancy restaurant isn’t about being so fancy and proper and putting up an image of status.

All along being by the water washing up and watching waves crash. Knowing time is running constantly - sometimes it’s just about being real, 

Antonio maintained both presence and an idea of reminding that everything is temporary and you should hold onto what is here right now as much as you can. Very thankful for this experience and it’s one we won’t forget. 

Thank you.

— Sunny & Happy
